page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare metal server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM.

This server type does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

Given the high density of dedicated compute cores, substantial system memory, and quad-GPU acceleration, this instance represents a high-tier hardware profile. The qualitative cost efficiency is centered on workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities and high network throughput. Appropriate workloads include GPU-accelerated machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and parallelized compute tasks that do not rely on high-speed local disk storage.
